name: Mohelnice (Czechia)
description: Three horizontal stripes of white, red and white in the ratio 1:8:1, with six white triangles arranged in three rows in the red.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 27 April 1999 (decision No. 15) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
